acceptance_predicates.description: A documented ASB command/script writes the extracted data model, entity storage, and command relation graph as a valid Graphviz DOT file on disk.
The same command converts DOT to SVG when Graphviz is available, with a deterministic fallback/error that does not lose the DOT artifact.
The SVG uses a readable developer-screen layout with clustered model/entity/command/lifecycle regions, useful labels, stable edges, and detail preserved without requiring manual graph editing.
DOT and SVG contain names and safe metadata only; API-key values, raw environment values, private paths, and secret-bearing payloads never appear.

definition_of_done: Developers can run one documented extraction command and receive a complete DOT plus readable SVG dataflow map on disk.

outputs.description: Developer-screen-oriented SVG rendering of the same graph.

gates.description: DOT parses, SVG renders, graph counts match the registry, and privacy scans pass.
